name: llama-vulkan-4090
description: Upstream ggml-org official Vulkan llama.cpp build, mirrored on the 4090 box (x86_64). Runs on NVIDIA RTX 4090 via the NVIDIA Vulkan ICD (the dispatcher injects --gpus all + NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES=all; units pass VK_DRIVER_FILES=/usr/share/vulkan/icd.d/nvidia_icd.json). Same upstream image as llama-vulkan-halo/spark; Vulkan is vendor-agnostic.
